label: offByOne: Flare's handle h maps to the kernel's handle h + 1
noWrap: the mod-8 wrap is dropped, so 8...15 and negative handles fall back to the top-left
cornerAsEdge: the top-left corner counts as a y-only edge like top and bottom
oppositeIsNeighbour: the fixed handle is two steps round the ring instead of four
squareCorner: a handle's spot is its 0-size square's min corner on a size-1 square, half a point off
replace: BoxMath.handles(of: box, size: 1)[handle].map { Rect(minX: $0.minX, minY: $0.minY, maxX: $0.minX, maxY: $0.minY) }
